basis: Seed observations that vm/SPEC.md section 8 cites and no golden can carry: the seed fails, its two lanes disagree, or it succeeds where D23 refuses. Each source runs on both lanes; the native lane is the reference. The review of each lane's exit and stdout is fixed before observation, from the review of round 11; the lanes' bytes are frozen by `check-spec.py --freeze-new`. A witness is evidence for the text and never a VM expectation.

witnesses.name: main-lambda-print
witnesses.note: main is a bare `R => k => ...`: `IO.print("direct")(R, k)`. Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: main-lambda-continue
witnesses.note: main = `R => k => k(Unit{})`. Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'f.j')

witnesses.name: main-lambda-halt
witnesses.note: main = `R => k => Halt{1, "boom"}`. Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: main-lambda-let
witnesses.note: a let-bound dead request beside a bare lambda main (DECISIONS finding 13 as first reported). Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: main-lambda-nolet
witnesses.note: the same source without the let: the crash is main's form, not the let. Its call-shaped twin with the let is the golden `let-dropped-request`.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: case-request-default-only
witnesses.note: `case _: d` over a request: never read, both lanes run and the request is never performed.

witnesses.name: case-request-binder
witnesses.note: `case y: d` over a request: never read, both lanes run.

witnesses.name: case-request-emit-default
witnesses.note: an Emit arm and a catch-all over a request: the native lane takes the catch-all, the Bun lane fail-stops.

witnesses.name: case-request-both-arms
witnesses.note: arms for Emit and Halt over a request: both lanes fail-stop (the seed's own tests/io/request_out_of_band.bend).

witnesses.name: case-request-emit-default-u32
witnesses.note: an Emit arm (1) and a catch-all (2) over a request, printed: the native lane prints 2, the Bun lane fail-stops.

witnesses.name: case-request-halt-default-u32
witnesses.note: a Halt arm (3) and a catch-all (4) over a request, printed: the native lane prints 4, the Bun lane fail-stops.
